question: What was the unique campaign launched by India to celebrate International Snow Leopard Day 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**#23for23**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India celebrated International Snow Leopard Day with the unique campaign #23for23, promoting 23 minutes of physical activity to raise awareness about snow leopard conservation.
 
• International Snow Leopard Day 2025 was observed on October 23, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The campaign was led by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav, with enthusiastic participation from citizens, institutions, and the Indian Army.
 
• India’s snow leopard conservation efforts were highlighted, with the first-ever Snow Leopard Census recording 718 individuals, including 477 in Ladakh.
 
• The campaign is part of the Global Snow Leopard and Ecosystem Protection Programme (GSLEP), aiming to raise awareness for the species’ conservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Snow Leopard Trust and GSLEP are global organizations driving efforts to protect snow leopards and their ecosystems.
 
• The campaign aligns with India's commitment to wildlife conservation under Prime Minister Modi's leadership.
